text:
Jane L: Quick sync — finalizing crosspost plan for the Product Launch webinar (next Wed). Need assets + routing plan by EOD tomorrow.
Carlos: Which platforms are we prioritizing? X main thread + LinkedIn post + short clip for stories.
Maya: Confirmed. Also want 3 variations of copy for AB testing (bench/narrative/technical).
Sam (creative): On it. Can we get a clear brief? hero image + 30s clip + 3 slide PNGs + 1 GIF.
Jane L: Copy brief in drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cLaunchAssets (please add assets to /final).
Sam (creative): Adding initial comps by 5pm. Will include desktop & mobile crops.
Ravi (ads): For paid boost, send me the hero + 15s clip by tomorrow noon. I'll prep UTM tagging and audience.
Maya: Draft copy variants (short, narrative, benchmark) — posting cadence suggestion below:
```
Wed 10:00 PT - X thread (hero + short clip)
Wed 11:00 PT - LinkedIn post (long-form narrative)
Wed 13:00 PT - X follow thread w/ benchmark highlight + CTA
Thu 09:00 PT - Reminder post + signup clip (stories)
```
Jane L: Love it. Sam — can you surface 3 headline options per variant? Keep one option optimized for engagement (question lead).
Sam (creative): Yep. Also tagging @Maya for tone direction.
Maya: Tone: confident, product-first, but approachable. Insert one stat-driven line for benchmark variant.
Carlos: On inbound — Liam (SDR) will own hot leads. SDR-bot: New lead routing rule requested: if signups >1.5x baseline in first hour, spin up SDR cadence and mark as priority.
SDR-bot: action: route webinar signups with company size >50 to #sdr-inbound and email liam@redwood.ai.
Liam: Got it. I'll set up a triage doc and 2-person on-call for first 3 hours post-event.
Ravi (ads): For UTM scheme use: ?utm_source=organic&utm_medium=xlnk&utm_campaign=webinar_launch_v1
Maya: Can someone draft the benchmark line? I suggest: "Benchmarked at 7x throughput improvements in worst-case tail — see demo." Needs approval.
Jane L: Slight tweak: avoid exact numbers in social copy — use "significant throughput gains" for social, reserve numbers for blog/bench page.
Maya: Noted. I'll make the three variants and drop them in the drive.
Sam (creative): Quick ask — preferred brand color for the hero gradient? Using teal or indigo.
Carlos: Teal for X hero, indigo for LinkedIn carousel. Keeps contrast.
Jane L: Timeline recap: assets in drive by EOD tomorrow, copy variants in by 10am tomorrow, ad-ready clip by noon. Everyone react with :thumbsup: when you can hit that.
Sam (creative): :thumbsup:
Maya: :thumbsup:
Ravi (ads): :thumbsup:
Liam: :thumbsup:
Carlos: Quick QA note — after posting, let’s monitor impressions vs CTR for first 2 hours and be ready to pin the highest-performing post.
Jane L: Agreed. Who will own live monitoring?
Ravi (ads): I'll watch paid and organic metrics for first hour. Maya — can you monitor hashtags and replies?
Maya: On it. I'll capture top 5 replies and escalate any support asks to #support.
Jane L: Perfect. One more: engagement follow-up play — reply template for top replies and a DM template to top engagers (offer 1:1 demo). Maya + Liam draft and drop in drive.
Liam: Drafting now. Will include SDR script and qualification checklist.
Sam (creative): Uploading first comps to drive now: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cLaunchAssets
Carlos: Thanks — will sync UTMs once assets final.
Jane L: Awesome team — we'll huddle 9:30am tomorrow for final sign-off. Short stand: confirm assets + copy.
Maya: See you then.
SDR-bot: Reminder set for 2024-06-11 09:30:00 PT for channel.
